title: Please remove all rules without an automated fix from default rules
author: zsimic
body_preview: ### Summary  Ruff v0.16.0 (https://astral.sh/blog/ruff-v0.16.0) enabled some rules by default without those rules having an automated fix via `ruff check --fix`.
